FQHESphereFermionsWithSpinCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereFermionsWithSpinCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 5)

    --lzsymmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --szsymmetrized-basis : use Sz <-> -Sz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-sz=0)
    --minus-szparity : select the  Sz <-> -Sz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --nbrspin-polarized : number of orbitals which ar fully spin up polarized (from the one with the lowest momentum) (default value = 0)
    --all-sz : use Hilbert-space with all values of sz
    --gutzwiller : use Gutzwiller projection in orbital space (i.e., no double occupation in orbital space)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    -z, --total-lz : twice the lz value corresponding to the eigenvector (override autodetection from input file name if greater or equal to zero) (default value = 0)
    --landau-level : index of the Landau level (n=0 being the LLL). WARNING: if using this option, l+1 should be the total number of orbitals that defines your input state (i.e., the flux Q will be determined from l=2Q+2n) (default value = 0)
    -e, --eigenstate : name of the file containing the eigenstate
    -i, --interaction-name : name of the interaction (used for output file name)
    -a, --add-filename : add a string with additional informations to the output file name(just before the .dat extension)
    --coefficients-only : only compute the one or two body coefficients that are requested to evaluate the density-density correlation
    --spinflip-odlro : compute off-diagonal long range order, c_{up,S}^+ c_{down,-S}^+ c_{up,-S} c_{down,S}
    --use-twoLLs : use two Landau levels instead of two spin species. WARNING: the Hilbert space will be the same for both
    --first-LLindex : index of first Landau level (if two Landau levels are used) (default value = 0)
    --second-LLindex : index of second Landau level (if two Landau levels are used) (default value = 0)
    -b, --bilayer : adjust normalization as a bilayer correlation function
    --shift : calculate 'shift' as defined for bilayer states
    -n, --nbr-points : number of point to evaluate (default value = 1000)
    -r, --radians : set units to radians instead of magnetic lengths
    --density : plot density insted of density-density correlation

precalculation options:
    --fast-search : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast state search (in Mbytes) (default value = 9)
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the haldane or symmetrized bases)
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the haldane or symmetrized bases)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with rhorho extension

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode

misc options:

global options:
